description: Angular component class for configuring a toggle button widget in the Thingsboard UI, including form setup, validation, and configuration output.

classes.name: ToggleButtonBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring toggle button widget settings in the Thingsboard UI.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for toggle button configuration.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided widget configuration data.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and returns the widget configuration data based on form values.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on current form values.

methods.name: getCardButtons
methods.description: Determines which card buttons should be enabled based on widget config.

methods.name: setCardButtons
methods.description: Sets card button states in widget config based on provided button list.
